payload.title: Figure and image rules are per site
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-0cb875.

`data/figures/rules.md` is one file for every site. Each site's prompts are built only from its own rules. Humorus keeps the rule that no generated image shows a real person.
